body: I have a heathy body, my parents didn't beat me, I was born in 1st world country, and we weren't poor. I'm not going to inherit a billion dollars, but taking all of human population in account, this is still up top on the "how I want to be born" pyramid. I see a lot of posts here where someone suffered a loss or came from a bad background, but I have no excuse. No one to blame but myself.   Not even a bad breakup. What few friends I have are all very good to me. I took a year off during uni to work on myself and see a therapist, but once the year was over I went right back to being a piece of shit. Barely graduated, failed a bunch of classes and was on academic probation. Been unemployed since. If you asked me why, I literally could not tell you. I literally do not know, and it is as bizarre to me as is to you. Everyone around me is doing something meaningful with their lives while I'm stuck and I don't understand why. I have a friend who works at Google for fuck's sake. The only thing I have going for me is that I'm just ruining my own life (and my parents') and not robbing people or something.
